notes: Shape of <frames-dir>/labels.json for embed-frames.py and score-frames.py. The real file describes frames from the user's library and stays outside the repo. kind: visual (describes what is on screen), narration (a script sentence that neither describes the frame nor copies on-screen text), transcript (a burned-in subtitle line rewritten as a script sentence), screen-text (asks for words shown on screen), none (no frame matches). relevant lists every matching frame id from manifest.json.
